reason: Registers a see_image tool that reads image files and returns model-generated descriptions through configurable OpenAI-compatible vision backends.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型读取图像文件并返回文字描述的 DeepSeek Harness 工具插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness tool plugin that reads image files and returns text descriptions through configurable OpenAI-compatible vision models.

capabilities: Reads image files through the host file service
Base64-encodes image data and sends it to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Uses configured API credentials or GitHub Copilot OAuth tokens for remote requests
Writes refreshed Copilot credentials to local DSH credential files
